method: Original 7 labels retained. All 23 previously unknown origins were checked against GitHub PR metadata and scope, with bounded source review. Unknown is excluded from precision/recall. Author hints, same-project, already-known adaptation, and documentation-only negatives are tracked independently from external positives. No retrieval output accessed. No physical tests performed. One live head differs from the freeze and is not promoted.

cases.decision: Frozen head differs; live PR is not a fair substitute for the original input.

Disable the collected early-pipelines scheduling history without deleting or disabling the shader cache or native pipeline library. Check old history stays intact, then isolate same-cache startup order.
cases.note: Source explicitly linked in the origin. No cross-fork visual validation is claimed.

cases.decision: Reuse the card-room retry test across later(), partly(), and recheck(). Ensure a stale retry does not remove the hold for a newer descriptor generation.
cases.note: The origin description already names both sources. Classify declared adaptation, not a novel find.

cases.decision: Closed unmerged; earlier in-project parallelization is mentioned but no actionable external counterpart was verified for the specific threshold and scoped workload.

The author already points to Dawn residency. Its 95% budget-cap calculation corroborates the default; test reserve handling independently, since equal budget percentages do not establish equal adapter behavior.
Excluded from technical grading because it is a defensive host-profiler input validation change.
The origin discloses provenance. Reuse the bounded queue-coverage test: submit 32,771 sparse writes against a 32,768-entry queue and assert every original range remains covered after compaction.
The antecedent is in the same project. Compare an allow-listed program, an unlisted program, and the unset/off controls before proposing a port; a global route switch would conflate the two paths.
Validate launcher cold/warm, explicit skip, and failed-pretranslation continuation with a stand-in executable.
cases.note: Named by the origin, inside the receiver. Exclude from cross-project novelty and recall.

cases.decision: The change documents an already published same-project preset comparison. A cross-project performance patch is irrelevant to the task.

Add a two-mode check using a path whose OEM and ANSI encodings differ. GetDiskFreeSpaceA must convert via the current process file API mode and find the same path as GetDiskFreeSpaceW in BOTH modes; restore process mode afterward. Avoid conflating GetDiskFreeSpaceExA fallback with the narrower API.
cases.note: The origin already has an OEM-vs-Wide test and names the independent fork's one-line fix. Wine/mode-switch evidence covers the additional ANSI/OEM transition. The expected search entity is independent implementation or public API contract with equivalent detail.

cases.decision: Retest AMD/RDNA2 compile behavior against the shader-stage-specific loop-budget change. The apparent device-loss similarity to RTX 5080 in #2929/#2930 is a separate DXIL-shape regression with a different tested lever.

Logical parking, GPU completion and releasing allocator memory are distinct. D3D12Multithreading offers a fence-reuse boundary reference; it does not establish that early allocator disposal or an alternate implementation is applicable to this parking path.
The alternative #2929 has the identical diff; the revert targets #2247. Use the paired RTX 5080 reproduction and treat the closed duplicate as lineage, not an independent fix.
The alternative #2930 has the identical diff; both revert the #2247 pixel-shader prelude shape change. Do not recommend transferring the reverted form or infer applicability to AMD RDNA2.
This adds same-project XGameSave diagnostics to distinguish a missing save call from a failed call. No equivalent external diagnostic was verified from public source.
Check the edit against the receiving repository's existing code. This is wording about existing file advancement, duplicated format documentation, and a truncated prose fragment.
cases.note: The public diff changes only docs/animation.md. A datastream overread patch elsewhere is a hard negative and not useful here. This does not assert the entire world contains no equivalent tool.

cases.decision: Documentation/link consolidation; there is no implementation change for discovery to explain or carry.
Check that the documentation points to the current receiving-repo code and removes a truncated merge fragment.
cases.note: The public diff changes only docs/restofworld.md and asks for existing links, not decoder changes. A cross-project mesh decoding feature would not answer this review.

cases.decision: This change updates linked documentation and flags without implementing a runtime path.
The origin names a VIctory-7900XTX base and three independent options. The stated build comparison is not an exact individual patch or equivalent measurement, so external transfer remains unverified.

Preserving indirect work across a proven non-storing compute dispatch is distinct from deleting a redundant UAV barrier or narrowing a producer scope. The nearby patches do not prove this dispatch classification safe.
The patch covers BVH staging/reclamation, a fence boundary and low-budget fallback; a matched external code path with the same constraints was not verified.
The ambient gather pass narrows synchronization in its own compute path. The broad UAV reduction in #474 is a look-alike; it does not prove the shader-local producer/consumer scope.
The D3D12 UAV rule is relevant but cannot certify three removals without each path's producer-consumer proof. The #475 pass-local edit is not equivalent.

The author already names FreeBSD. Its implementation provides a concrete invalid timestamp boundary test. The Windows whole-second path must be assessed separately before claiming subsecond equivalence.
The new public wrapper forwards to the existing local setter and shares its precedence. Reuse the pinned round-trip test and its invalid option control before planning outside adaptation.
The patch adds a successful stub rather than ownership/destruction; no matched independent public contract was verified for handle lifecycle.
A packet-size result depends on contiguous-register packing in this implementation. A sufficient published independent implementation/test was not verified.

Add INPUT_ATTACHMENT to the view-format feature matrix, testing COLOR_ATTACHMENT or DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT independently of the COLOR_ATTACHMENT usage bit. Under test, one override with SAMPLED remaining succeeds; a zero mask exercises a distinct validation error. Use override bits within the parent image's allowed usage. Verify against the supported Vulkan version/extension before proposing runtime behavior.
cases.note: The PR's mapping covers six other usage bits but not INPUT_ATTACHMENT. the historical issue reproduces validation remaining after stripping COLOR_ATTACHMENT on the same packed view format. Treat port/adaptation as a suggestion, not verified project behavior.
